Minion attempts an action, is blocked, plays change of target or
psychomachia to cancel the action.

He has attemtped that action, so he cannot attempt that same action
again this turn can he?

Or since it was cancelled can he attempt it again?

T

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Talonz51" asked:

> Minion attempts an action, is blocked, plays change of target or
> psychomachia to cancel the action.

> He has attemtped that action, so he cannot attempt that same action
> again this turn can he?

No.

Change of Target will prohibit him from taking it again (card text).

5-1-02 RTR states =
PSYCHOMACHIA is playable when an ally or younger vampire blocks
(successfully) - not merely on the attempt. (So the NRA rule, if used,
would "kick in" to prevent the vampire from attempting the same type of
action again).

> Or since it was cancelled can he attempt it again?

No.

This is like cancelling a check, even though the check is
cancelled, you cannot re-use it. The action was being
performed, was cancelled, and cannot be repeated.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Almost. Psychomachia was a Change of Target without the action resolution
(successful block) requirement. That is, you could play it even if
the blocking minion didn't have sufficient stealth (useful if your
stealthy bleed got bounced - you just invite the new target to try to
block and Psycho out of it).

And, without action resolution, the NRA doesn't kick in.

1. [6.2.2.2]
Note that you need to match stealt to successfully block.
Not to attempt to block (which should be ovbious, since you cannot add
stealth unless and until you're attempting to block).

It kicks on on the 31st of May, as stated.

Psychomachia operates by card text until the errata kicks in, yes.

RTR takes effect as indicated explicitly in the RTR.
